[994] user: Текущий статус коротко:

Корректность:
- CPU-оракул для backward: `output_dim=1/3/11`.
- Mixed precision ошибка: `output_dim=1/3/17/128`.
- Полный локальный Docker gate: `ctest 29/29` зеленый.
- Проверяются артефакты, `metadata.env`, `profile.jsonl`, `layers.json`, формат весов и backend `input_grad`.

Скорость локально на p888, batch `53248`:
- `output_dim=1`: обычно `~286-296k` состояний/с, свежий короткий контрольный прогон был `~268k` из-за шума.
- `output_dim=128`: `~311k` состояний/с.
- Лучший текущий `input_grad`: `dense_one_hot_half_gemm`, около `46-49 мс`.
- Owner-write варианты хуже: group `~60-72k`, chunked `~128k` состояний/с.

Что реально помогло:
- Половинные веса/активации для линейных слоев.
- Постоянное зеркало весов в `fp16`, без конверсии всех весов каждый шаг.
- `cuBLASLt` dense half GEMM для `input_grad`.
- Автопаддинг размеров слоев: например `hd1 2556 -> 2560`, `hd2 218 -> 224`.
- Универсальный `output_dim`, сейчас 1 и 128 работают в быстром пути.

Что не помогло:
- Принудительный CUTLASS вместо `cuBLASLt`: медленнее.
- `cuBLASLt` heuristic-алгоритм без workspace: ломал реальный p888, убрал.
- `input_forward` vec8 и двухсэмпловый kernel: хуже.
- Owner-write `input_grad`: корректный, но сильно медленнее dense GEMM.

Следующий реальный шаг для ускорения: не трогать старые проигравшие ветки, а делать управляемый статический GEMM-план: либо `cuBLASLt` с заранее выделенным workspace в memory plan, либо отдельный CUTLASS-путь под manifest формы.

    char* end = nullptr;

    if (end == text || *end != '\0') {

For the current cluster transformer test shape:\n\n```text\nBEAM_STREAM3_RING_SLOTS=8\nBEAM_STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=2\nBEAM_RING_GRAPH_EXECS_PER_LANE=32\n```\n\nExpected production log:\n\n```text\nruntime_ring_count=8\nruntime_ring_slot_count=8\nruntime_ring_slot_graph_execs=64\nruntime_ring_slot_graph_execs_per_lane=32\n```\n\nLauncher aliases:\n\n```text\nMEGAMINX_STREAM1_BACKEND=native_windowed_graph\nMEGAMINX_STREAM1_BACKEND=native_graph_window\n```\n\nBoth aliases compile/use `BEAM_STREAM1_EXECUTOR=native_cuda_graph` and default `BEAM_RING_GRAPH_EXECS_PER_LANE=32`.\n\nCluster baseline that motivated this change:\n\n```text\nnative_eager 700M p990 depth 7: depth_sec=328.366, ring_slot_jobs=80230\n80230 * 512 * 24 / 328.366 = 3.002M candidates/s\nold MLP 700M depth step was about 85s, roughly 11.6M candidates/s at the same frontier size\nisolated transformer native graph best was 4.46M candidates/s at b_micro=512 concurrency=2\n```\n\nVerification:\n\n```text\nbash -n hpc/start_8xa100_libtorch_megaminx.sh hpc/solve_then_reflect.sh\ncmake -S . -B build-windowed-graph-check -DCUTLASS_DIR=/opt/cutlass -DBEAM_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=75\ncmake --build build-windowed-graph-check --target production_runner contract_tests -j2\n./build-windowed-graph-check/contract_tests\n```\n\nResult:\n\n```text\n[100%] Built target production_runner\n[100%] Built target contract_tests\ncontract_tests=pass\n```\n'@\n[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $testResults 'mephi_megaminx_transformer_windowed_graph_2026-07-06.md'), $report, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))\n$change = @'\n- Added bounded native CUDA Graph windowing for Stream1 piece-transformer runs via `BEAM_RING_GRAPH_EXECS_PER_LANE`. The runtime caps derived physical `ring_count` when the env var is set, so graph execution resources stay bounded while the dispatcher continues reusing physical rings over the full frontier. Added `native_windowed_graph` / `native_graph_window` launcher aliases with a default cap of 32 graph execs per lane, and production logs now print the effective runtime ring/graph window. [994] user: Текущий статус коротко:

Корректность:
- CPU-оракул для backward: `output_dim=1/3/11`.
- Mixed precision ошибка: `output_dim=1/3/17/128`.
- Полный локальный Docker gate: `ctest 29/29` зеленый.
- Проверяются артефакты, `metadata.env`, `profile.jsonl`, `layers.json`, формат весов и backend `input_grad`.

Скорость локально на p888, batch `53248`:
- `output_dim=1`: обычно `~286-296k` состояний/с, свежий короткий контрольный прогон был `~268k` из-за шума.
- `output_dim=128`: `~311k` состояний/с.
- Лучший текущий `input_grad`: `dense_one_hot_half_gemm`, около `46-49 мс`.
- Owner-write варианты хуже: group `~60-72k`, chunked `~128k` состояний/с.

Что реально помогло:
- Половинные веса/активации для линейных слоев.
- Постоянное зеркало весов в `fp16`, без конверсии всех весов каждый шаг.
- `cuBLASLt` dense half GEMM для `input_grad`.
- Автопаддинг размеров слоев: например `hd1 2556 -> 2560`, `hd2 218 -> 224`.
- Универсальный `output_dim`, сейчас 1 и 128 работают в быстром пути.

Что не помогло:
- Принудительный CUTLASS вместо `cuBLASLt`: медленнее.
- `cuBLASLt` heuristic-алгоритм без workspace: ломал реальный p888, убрал.
- `input_forward` vec8 и двухсэмпловый kernel: хуже.
- Owner-write `input_grad`: корректный, но сильно медленнее dense GEMM.

Следующий реальный шаг для ускорения: не трогать старые проигравшие ветки, а делать управляемый статический GEMM-план: либо `cuBLASLt` с заранее выделенным workspace в memory plan, либо отдельный CUTLASS-путь под manifest формы.

Как тебе вот такое? Это для МЛП-обучения сделано, но мб что-то полезное может для инференса трансформера бить

namespace beam {

std::uint64_t parse_u64(const char* text, const char* name) {
    char* end = nullptr;
    const unsigned long long value = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
    if (end == text || *end != '\0') {
        throw std::invalid_argument(std::string("invalid numeric argument: ") + name);
    }
    return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(value);

## Summary

- Добавить новый benchmark tool `tools/stream_pipeline_benchmark.cu`, который использует реальные dispatcher/static-memory/graph-template пути, а не отдельную игрушечную реализацию.
- В `cuda/dispatcher` добавить безопасный debug/bench stop-stage:
  - default `Full`, production поведение не меняется;
  - `AfterStream12`: дождаться всех Stream1+2 ring-slot graphs и остановиться;
  - `AfterStream3`: прогнать Stream3 для готовых rings и остановиться до Stream4.
- Расширить `hpc/bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh` режимом `RUN_PIPELINE_SMOKE=1`, который пишет TSV:
  `mode,window,b_micro,concurrency,ring_slots,stream3_batch,graph_window_jobs,physical_jobs,candidates_per_sec,depth_like_ms,status,log`.

## Test Matrix
- Основной smoke на A100:
  - `B_MICRO=512`
  - `STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=2`
  - `BEAM_RING_GRAPH_EXECS_PER_LANE=16 32 64`
  - modes: `stream12 stream123`
  - Stream3 slots не трогать, оставить как в нормальном 700M конфиге.
- Интерпретация:
  - `stream12 ~= 4.4M` значит Stream2 и windowed graph норм, просадка дальше.
  - `stream12 << 4.4M` значит проблема в graph-window scheduler, job-index memcpy/event sync или Stream2 graph kernel.
  - `stream123 << stream12` значит основной проеб в Stream3.
  - если `stream123` норм, а full depth медленный, тогда дальше отдельно смотреть Stream4/5/history.

std::uint32_t read_depth_index_host(const StaticDeviceMemory& memory) {
    std::uint32_t current_depth = 0;
    check_cuda(cudaMemcpy(
        &current_depth,
        memory.current_depth,
        sizeof(current_depth),
        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost), "cudaMemcpy depth flow current depth");
    return current_depth == 0U ? UINT32_MAX : current_depth - 1U;
}

std::uint64_t sum_u32_device_array_host(
    const std::uint32_t* device,
    std::uint32_t count,
    const char* op) {
    if (count == 0U) {
        return 0;
    }
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> host(count);
    check_cuda(cudaMemcpy(
        host.data(),
        device,
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(count) * sizeof(std::uint32_t),
        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost), op);
    std::uint64_t total = 0;
    for (std::uint32_t value : host) {
        total += value;
    }
    return total;
}

## Summary

- Добавить новый benchmark tool `tools/stream_pipeline_benchmark.cu`, который использует реальные dispatcher/static-memory/graph-template пути, а не отдельную игрушечную реализацию.

std::uint32_t read_depth_index_host(const StaticDeviceMemory& memory) {
    std::uint32_t current_depth = 0;
    check_cuda(cudaMemcpy(
        &current_depth,
        memory.current_depth,
        sizeof(current_depth),
        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost), "cudaMemcpy depth flow current depth");
    return current_depth == 0U ? UINT32_MAX : current_depth - 1U;
}

std::uint64_t sum_u32_device_array_host(
    const std::uint32_t* device,
    std::uint32_t count,
    const char* op) {
    if (count == 0U) {
        return 0;
    }
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> host(count);
    check_cuda(cudaMemcpy(
        host.data(),
        device,
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(count) * sizeof(std::uint32_t),
        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost), op);
    std::uint64_t total = 0;
    for (std::uint32_t value : host) {
        total += value;
    }
    return total;
}

# Stream Pipeline Graph Smoke 2026-07-06

## Scope

Implemented a dispatcher-backed smoke benchmark for the native Stream1 piece-transformer graph path:

- `stream12`: Stream1 native piece-transformer CUDA Graph plus Stream2 hash/goal in the real ring-slot dispatcher graph.
- `stream123`: the same ring-slot graph path plus the real Stream3 ring graph, stopping before Stream4/Stream5/history/final.
- `BEAM_RING_GRAPH_EXECS_PER_LANE` is measured as a graph-template window (`16/32/64`) and does not alter Stream3 slots or production defaults.

Production behavior remains the default `DepthDispatchStopStage::Full`.

## Changed Files

- `cuda/dispatcher.hpp`: added `DepthDispatchStopStage` enum and optional `stop_stage` argument defaulting to `Full`.
- `cuda/dispatcher.cu`: added benchmark-only `AfterStream12` and `AfterStream3` stop points, plus a fail-fast guard if Stream3 benchmark mode hits shard backpressure without Stream4.
- `tools/stream_pipeline_benchmark.cu`: new single-process smoke tool using real static memory, dispatcher graphs, native piece-transformer Stream1, Stream2, and optionally Stream3.
- `CMakeLists.txt`: new `stream_pipeline_benchmark` target.
- `hpc/bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh`: new `RUN_PIPELINE_SMOKE=1` mode and TSV summary.

## Local Verification

Docker image: `gpu-dev-cutlass-nsight:2026-05-24`.

Build command:

```bash
cmake -S . -B build-stream-pipeline-smoke -DCUTLASS_DIR=/opt/cutlass -DBEAM_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=75
cmake --build build-stream-pipeline-smoke --target production_runner stream_pipeline_benchmark contract_tests stream2_cuda_tests dispatcher_cuda_tests -j2
```

Result:

```text
Built target production_runner
Built target stream_pipeline_benchmark
Built target contract_tests
Built target stream2_cuda_tests
Built target dispatcher_cuda_tests
```

Focused rebui<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="141" />tests`, and `dispatcher_cuda_tests` must run on the A100 cluster.

## Cluster Smoke Commands

Copy/update the script after pulling this branch on the cluster, then run one short `stream12 window=32` smoke first:

```bash
cd /mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100/repo
git fetch origin codex/stream1-piece-transformer --depth 1
git checkout -B codex/stream1-piece-transformer origin/codex/stream1-piece-transformer
git log -1 --oneline

cd /mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100
cp repo/hpc/bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh .
sed -i 's/\r$//' bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh
bash -n bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh
chmod +x bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh

sbatch -p kaf12 \
  --export=ALL,RUN_ISOLATED_STREAM1=0,RUN_PIPELINE_SMOKE=1,PIPELINE_SMOKE_MODES=stream12,PIPELINE_GRAPH_WINDOW_SWEEP=32,PIPELINE_B_MICRO_SWEEP=512,PIPELINE_CONCURRENCY_SWEEP=2 \
  bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh
```

Full requested sweep after the first smoke is clean:

```bash
sbatch -p kaf12 \
  --export=ALL,RUN_ISOLATED_STREAM1=0,RUN_PIPELINE_SMOKE=1,PIPELINE_SMOKE_MODES="stream12 stream123",PIPELINE_GRAPH_WINDOW_SWEEP="16 32 64",PIPELINE_B_MICRO_SWEEP=512,PIPELINE_CONCURRENCY_SWEEP=2 \
  bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh
```

TSV path printed by the job:

```text
logs/tuning_<jobid>/megaminx_transformer_pipeline_smoke_<jobid>.tsv
```

Expected columns:

```text
mode,window,b_micro,concurrency,ring_slots,stream3_batch,graph_window_jobs,physical_jobs,candidates_per_sec,depth_like_ms,status,log
```

## Interpretation

- `stream12` near the isolated native Stream1 baseline (`~4.476M cand/s`) means Stream2 plus graph-window scheduling is fine.
- `stream12` far below baseline points at graph-window scheduling, job-index memcpy/event synchronization, or Stream2 graph work.
- `stream123` far below `stream12` points at Stream3.
- If `stream123` is healthy while full solve is slow, continue profiling Stream4/5/history/finalization.

# Stream Pipeline Graph Smoke 2026-07-06

## Scope

Implemented a dispatcher-backed smoke benchmark for the native Stream1 piece-transformer graph path:

- `stream12`: Stream1 native piece-transformer CUDA Graph plus Stream2 hash/goal in the real ring-slot dispatcher graph.
- `stream123`: the same ring-slot graph path plus the real Stream3 ring graph, stopping before Stream4/Stream5/history/final.
- `BEAM_RING_GRAPH_EXECS_PER_LANE` is measured as a graph-template window (`16/32/64`) and does not alter Stream3 slots or production defaults.

Production behavior remains the default `DepthDispatchStopStage::Full`.

## Changed Files

- `cuda/dispatcher.hpp`: added `DepthDispatchStopStage` enum and optional `stop_stage` argument defaulting to `Full`.
- `cuda/dispatcher.cu`: added benchmark-only `AfterStream12` and `AfterStream3` stop points, plus a fail-fast guard if Stream3 benchmark mode hits shard backpressure without Stream4.
- `tools/stream_pipeline_benchmark.cu`: new single-process smoke tool using real static memory, dispatcher graphs, native piece-transformer Stream1, Stream2, and optionally Stream3.
- `CMakeLists.txt`: new `stream_pipeline_benchmark` target.
- `hpc/bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh`: new `RUN_PIPELINE_SMOKE=1` mode and TSV summary.

## Local Verification

Docker image: `gpu-dev-cutlass-nsight:2026-05-24`.

Build command:

```bash
cmake -S . -B build-stream-pipeline-smoke -DCUTLASS_DIR=/opt/cutlass -DBEAM_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=75
cmake --build build-stream-pipeline-smoke --target production_runner stream_pipeline_benchmark contract_tests stream2_cuda_tests dispatcher_cuda_tests -j2
```

Result:

```text
Built target production_runner
Built target stream_pipeline_benchmark
Built target contract_tests
Built target stream2_cuda_tests
Built target dispatcher_cuda_tests
```

Focused rebui<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="141" />tests`, and `dispatcher_cuda_tests` must run on the A100 cluster.

## Cluster Smoke Commands

Copy/update the script after pulling this branch on the cluster, then run one short `stream12 window=32` smoke first:

```bash
cd /mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100/repo
git fetch origin codex/stream1-piece-transformer --depth 1
git checkout -B codex/stream1-piece-transformer origin/codex/stream1-piece-transformer
git log -1 --oneline

cd /mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100
cp repo/hpc/bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh .
sed -i 's/\r$//' bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh
bash -n bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh
chmod +x bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh

sbatch -p kaf12 \
  --export=ALL,RUN_ISOLATED_STREAM1=0,RUN_PIPELINE_SMOKE=1,PIPELINE_SMOKE_MODES=stream12,PIPELINE_GRAPH_WINDOW_SWEEP=32,PIPELINE_B_MICRO_SWEEP=512,PIPELINE_CONCURRENCY_SWEEP=2 \
  bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh
```

Full requested sweep after the first smoke is clean:

```bash
sbatch -p kaf12 \
  --export=ALL,RUN_ISOLATED_STREAM1=0,RUN_PIPELINE_SMOKE=1,PIPELINE_SMOKE_MODES="stream12 stream123",PIPELINE_GRAPH_WINDOW_SWEEP="16 32 64",PIPELINE_B_MICRO_SWEEP=512,PIPELINE_CONCURRENCY_SWEEP=2 \
  bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh
```

TSV path printed by the job:

```text
logs/tuning_<jobid>/megaminx_transformer_pipeline_smoke_<jobid>.tsv
```

Expected columns:

```text
mode,window,b_micro,concurrency,ring_slots,stream3_batch,graph_window_jobs,physical_jobs,candidates_per_sec,depth_like_ms,status,log
```

## Interpretation

- `stream12` near the isolated native Stream1 baseline (`~4.476M cand/s`) means Stream2 plus graph-window scheduling is fine.
- `stream12` far below baseline points at graph-window scheduling, job-index memcpy/event synchronization, or Stream2 graph work.
- `stream123` far below `stream12` points at Stream3.
- If `stream123` is healthy while full solve is slow, continue profiling Stream4/5/history/finalization.

# Stream1+2+3 Graph Smoke Bench

## Summary
Сделать отдельный smoke-бенч, который замеряет не только isolated Stream1, а реальные графовые куски dispatcher pipeline:

- `stream12`: Stream1 transformer native graph + Stream2 hash/goal в одном ring-slot CUDA Graph, с `BEAM_RING_GRAPH_EXECS_PER_LANE=16/32/64`.
- `stream123`: то же самое, плюс Stream3 ring graph, но без Stream4/Stream5/history/full solve.
- Сравнить с текущим baseline `native_cutlass graph b_micro=512 conc=2 ~= 4.476M cand/s`.

## Key Changes
- Добавить новый benchmark tool `tools/stream_pipeline_benchmark.cu`, который использует реальные dispatcher/static-memory/graph-template пути, а не отдельную игрушечную реализацию.
- В `cuda/dispatcher` добавить безопасный debug/bench stop-stage:
  - default `Full`, production поведение не меняется;
  - `AfterStream12`: дождаться всех Stream1+2 ring-slot graphs и остановиться;
  - `AfterStream3`: прогнать Stream3 для готовых rings и остановиться до Stream4.
- Расширить `hpc/bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh` режимом `RUN_PIPELINE_SMOKE=1`, который пишет TSV:
  `mode,window,b_micro,concurrency,ring_slots,stream3_batch,graph_window_jobs,physical_jobs,candidates_per_sec,depth_like_ms,status,log`.

## Test Matrix
- Основной smoke на A100:
  - `B_MICRO=512`
  - `STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=2`
  - `BEAM_RING_GRAPH_EXECS_PER_LANE=16 32 64`
  - modes: `stream12 stream123`
  - Stream3 slots не трогать, оставить как в нормальном 700M конфиге.
- Интерпретация:
  - `stream12 ~= 4.4M` значит Stream2 и windowed graph норм, просадка дальше.
  - `stream12 << 4.4M` значит проблема в graph-window scheduler, job-index memcpy/event sync или Stream2 graph kernel.
  - `stream123 << stream12` значит основной проеб в Stream3.
  - если `stream123` норм, а full depth медленный, тогда дальше отдельно смотреть Stream4/5/history.

## Verification
- Локально/Docker:
  - build `production_runner`, новый `stream_pipeline_benchmark`, `contract_tests`, `stream2_cuda_tests`, `dispatcher_cuda_tests`;
  - `ctest` без изменения MLP пути.
- Cluster smoke:
  - сначала один короткий прогон `stream12 window=32`;
  - затем полный sweep `stream12/stream123 x 16/32/64`.
- Записать результаты в `test_results/stream_pipeline_graph_smoke_2026-07-06.md`, а требования/изменения в `memory/PROMPTS.md` и `memory/CHANGELOG.md`.

## Assumptions
- Smoke делаем single-process на `cuda:0`, без NCCL и без Stream5: задача именно найти потери Stream1/2/3.
- Production solver defaults не меняются.
- Никаких fallback-режимов: только явный benchmark mode.

## Cluster Smoke Commands

Copy/update the script after pulling this branch on the cluster, then run one short `stream12 window=32` smoke first:

```bash
cd /mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100/repo
git fetch origin codex/stream1-piece-transformer --depth 1
git checkout -B codex/stream1-piece-transformer origin/codex/stream1-piece-transformer
git log -1 --oneline

cd /mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100
cp repo/hpc/bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh .
sed -i 's/\r$//' bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh
bash -n bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh
chmod +x bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh

export RUN_ISOLATED_STREAM1=0
export RUN_PIPELINE_SMOKE=1
export PIPELINE_SMOKE_MODES=stream12
export PIPELINE_GRAPH_WINDOW_SWEEP=32
export PIPELINE_B_MICRO_SWEEP=512
export PIPELINE_CONCURRENCY_SWEEP=2

sbatch -p kaf12 --export=ALL bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh
```

Full requested sweep after the first smoke is clean:

```bash
export RUN_ISOLATED_STREAM1=0
export RUN_PIPELINE_SMOKE=1
export PIPELINE_SMOKE_MODES="stream12 stream123"
export PIPELINE_GRAPH_WINDOW_SWEEP="16 32 64"
export PIPELINE_B_MICRO_SWEEP=512
export PIPELINE_CONCURRENCY_SWEEP=2

sbatch -p kaf12 --export=ALL bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh
```

TSV path printed by the job:

```text
logs/tuning_<jobid>/megaminx_transformer_pipeline_smoke_<jobid>.tsv
```

Expected columns:

```text
mode,window,b_micro,concurrency,ring_slots,stream3_batch,graph_window_jobs,physical_jobs,candidates_per_sec,depth_like_ms,status,log
```

## Interpretation

- `stream12` near the isolated native Stream1 baseline (`~4.476M cand/s`) means Stream2 plus graph-window scheduling is fine.
- `stream12` far below baseline points at graph-window scheduling, job-index memcpy/event synchronization, or Stream2 graph work.
- `stream123` far below `stream12` points at Stream3.
- If `stream123` is healthy while full solve is slow, continue profiling Stream4/5/history/finalization.

# Stream1+2+3 Graph Smoke Bench

## Summary
Сделать отдельный smoke-бенч, который замеряет не только isolated Stream1, а реальные графовые куски dispatcher pipeline:

- `stream12`: Stream1 transformer native graph + Stream2 hash/goal в одном ring-slot CUDA Graph, с `BEAM_RING_GRAPH_EXECS_PER_LANE=16/32/64`.
- `stream123`: то же самое, плюс Stream3 ring graph, но без Stream4/Stream5/history/full solve.
- Сравнить с текущим baseline `native_cutlass graph b_micro=512 conc=2 ~= 4.476M cand/s`.

## Key Changes
- Добавить новый benchmark tool `tools/stream_pipeline_benchmark.cu`, который использует реальные dispatcher/static-memory/graph-template пути, а не отдельную игрушечную реализацию.
- В `cuda/dispatcher` добавить безопасный debug/bench stop-stage:
  - default `Full`, production поведение не меняется;
  - `AfterStream12`: дождаться всех Stream1+2 ring-slot graphs и остановиться;
  - `AfterStream3`: прогнать Stream3 для готовых rings и остановиться до Stream4.
- Расширить `hpc/bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh` режимом `RUN_PIPELINE_SMOKE=1`, который пишет TSV:
  `mode,window,b_micro,concurrency,ring_slots,stream3_batch,graph_window_jobs,physical_jobs,candidates_per_sec,depth_like_ms,status,log`.

## Test Matrix
- Основной smoke на A100:
  - `B_MICRO=512`
  - `STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=2`
  - `BEAM_RING_GRAPH_EXECS_PER_LANE=16 32 64`
  - modes: `stream12 stream123`
  - Stream3 slots не трогать, оставить как в нормальном 700M конфиге.
- Интерпретация:
  - `stream12 ~= 4.4M` значит Stream2 и windowed graph норм, просадка дальше.
  - `stream12 << 4.4M` значит проблема в graph-window scheduler, job-index memcpy/event sync или Stream2 graph kernel.
  - `stream123 << stream12` значит основной проеб в Stream3.
  - если `stream123` норм, а full depth медленный, тогда дальше отдельно смотреть Stream4/5/history.

## Verification
- Локально/Docker:
  - build `production_runner`, новый `stream_pipeline_benchmark`, `contract_tests`, `stream2_cuda_tests`, `dispatcher_cuda_tests`;
  - `ctest` без изменения MLP пути.
- Cluster smoke:
  - сначала один короткий прогон `stream12 window=32`;

- Записать результаты в `test_results/stream_pipeline_graph_smoke_2026-07-06.md`, а требования/изменения в `memory/PROMPTS.md` и `memory/CHANGELOG.md`.

## Assumptions
- Smoke делаем single-process на `cuda:0`, без NCCL и без Stream5: задача именно найти потери Stream1/2/3.
- Production solver defaults не меняются.
- Никаких fallback-режимов: только явный benchmark mode.

## Cluster Smoke Commands

Copy/update the script after pulling this branch on the cluster, then run one short `stream12 window=32` smoke first:

```bash
cd /mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100/repo
git fetch origin codex/stream1-piece-transformer --depth 1
git checkout -B codex/stream1-piece-transformer origin/codex/stream1-piece-transformer
git log -1 --oneline

cd /mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100
cp repo/hpc/bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh .
sed -i 's/\r$//' bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh
bash -n bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh
chmod +x bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh

export RUN_ISOLATED_STREAM1=0
export RUN_PIPELINE_SMOKE=1
export PIPELINE_SMOKE_MODES=stream12
export PIPELINE_GRAPH_WINDOW_SWEEP=32
export PIPELINE_B_MICRO_SWEEP=512
export PIPELINE_CONCURRENCY_SWEEP=2

sbatch -p kaf12 --export=ALL bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh
```

Full requested sweep after the first smoke is clean:

```bash
export RUN_ISOLATED_STREAM1=0
export RUN_PIPELINE_SMOKE=1
export PIPELINE_SMOKE_MODES="stream12 stream123"
export PIPELINE_GRAPH_WINDOW_SWEEP="16 32 64"
export PIPELINE_B_MICRO_SWEEP=512
export PIPELINE_CONCURRENCY_SWEEP=2

sbatch -p kaf12 --export=ALL bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh
```

TSV path printed by the job:

```text
logs/tuning_<jobid>/megaminx_transformer_pipeline_smoke_<jobid>.tsv
```

Expected columns:

```text
mode,window,b_micro,concurrency,ring_slots,stream3_batch,graph_window_jobs,physical_jobs,candidates_per_sec,depth_like_ms,status,log
```

## Interpretation

- `stream12` near the isolated native Stream1 baseline (`~4.476M cand/s`) means Stream2 plus graph-window scheduling is fine.
- `stream12` far below baseline points at graph-window scheduling, job-index memcpy/event synchronization, or Stream2 graph work.
- `stream123` far below `stream12` points at Stream3.
- If `stream123` is healthy while full solve is slow, continue profiling Stream4/5/history/finalization.

# Work With Kaggle

Use this skill whenever the task involves Kaggle notebooks, kernels, datasets, or GPU validation runs.

## Project Memory First

For project repositories, read local project guidance before changing notebooks or source:

- `AGENTS.md`
- `memory/PROMPTS.md` and `memory/CHANGELOG.md`, especially recent Kaggle entries
- relevant `test_results/kaggle_*` reports for the same failure/config family

This project has many Kaggle-specific decisions preserved in memory. Do not assume a generic Kaggle workflow is correct when project memory says otherwise.

## Safety And Scope

- Do not upload or publish current uncommitted source to a Kaggle dataset unless the user explicitly approves external export.
- Prefer GitHub-backed Kaggle source when the user has selected GitHub as source of truth.
- Do not push a public Kaggle notebook/kernel unless the user explicitly approves publication or public push.
- Do not make C++/CUDA algorithmic changes while diagnosing Kaggle failures unless the user explicitly approves code changes. Config-only notebook changes are acceptable when useful and consistent with the request.
- Do not revert unrelated local changes. Kaggle notebook edits often coexist with dirty source changes.
- For multi-rank validation, do not fake `WORLD_SIZE=2` on one GPU with both ranks on `LO<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="684" />stop the run and inspect downloaded logs. This rule came from project memory and applies to diagnostic/watch tasks.
- Do not stop production/no-timeout runs unless the user explicitly asks or the notebook itself has a configured timeout.
- If a run appears hung because stdout is redirected, check rank log files and whether live-rank streaming is enabled before assuming a stall.
- Preserve logs even when stopping: terminate gracefully when possible, then download output files.

## Failure Diagnosis Checklist

After a Kaggle failure, collect and scan:

- Kaggle worker status and kernel version
- notebook stdout tail
- rank logs under the notebook output directory
- result JSONL/CSV summaries
- GPU budget/preflight output
- explicit Kaggle messages such as disk quota failures

Common patterns in this project:

- `KernelWorkerStatus.ERROR` plus "more disk space than is available" usually means disk quota/static history arena pressure.
- `return_code=-9` can indicate host RAM OOM.
- `code=3002` / `STREAM_FATAL_STREAM3_DOUBLE_BUFFER_OVERFLOW` points to Stream3/Stream4/threshold/capacity flow diagnostics.
- `final selected count does not match score phase counts` points to final selection/histogram/exact-count mismatch.
- `cudaGraphInstantiate: out of memory` may require config-only headroom/shard-capacity changes before deeper code work.
- Silent output after build may simply mean rank stdout is redirected and live rank logging is disabled.

Write a short report under `test_results/` for meaningful Kaggle validations, sweeps, failures, or launches.

## Response Style

- Be explicit about whether you changed source code, notebook config only, or only launched/monitored a run.
- Include Kaggle kernel slug/version/status when known.
- Include exact local report/log paths in `test_results/`.
- Keep recommendations tied to evidence from logs, not guesses.
- If the next step requires exporting source or publishing publicly, ask for explicit approval first.

# Project Agent Rules

## Operating Rule
- Read `AGENTS.md` before project edits.
- Update `memory/CHANGELOG.md` after meaningful code, config, or architecture changes.
- Update `memory/PROMPTS.md` with user prompts that define requirements.
- Store test outputs, logs, and verification notes under `test_results/`.
- Prefer agent-centered code: explicit contracts, deterministic tests, small files, low hidden state.

## Architecture Source
- Primary architecture contract: `ARCHITECTURE_NEED.md`.
- Current Stream 4 implementation rule: use threshold + compact + CUB/fixed-temp sort/reduce + compact; do not use Stream 4 hash-table dedup.

## Implementation Guardrails
- `State128` logical bytes are `v[0..119]`.
- `State128` padding bytes are `v[120..127]`.
- Persistent frontier padding must be zero.
- `FinalResponse` may temporarily store `target_local_idx` in `v[120..123]`.
- `Hash128` is one logical 128-bit key stored as `{lo, hi}`.
- `CandidateMeta` must remain 32 bytes and 32-byte aligned.
- Stream 3 payload id must be original candidate id, not compact index.
- Stream 4 must not apply shard top-k or semantic shard cap.

# Work With Kaggle

Use this skill whenever the task involves Kaggle notebooks, kernels, datasets, or GPU validation runs.

## Project Memory First

For project repositories, read local project guidance before changing notebooks or source:

- `AGENTS.md`
- `memory/PROMPTS.md` and `memory/CHANGELOG.md`, especially recent Kaggle entries
- relevant `test_results/kaggle_*` reports for the same failure/config family

This project has many Kaggle-specific decisions preserved in memory. Do not assume a generic Kaggle workflow is correct when project memory says otherwise.

## Safety And Scope

- Do not upload or publish current uncommitted source to a Kaggle dataset unless the user explicitly approves external export.
- Prefer GitHub-backed Kaggle source when the user has selected GitHub as source of truth.
- Do not push a public Kaggle notebook/kernel unless the user explicitly approves publication or public push.
- Do not make C++/CUDA algorithmic changes while diagnosing Kaggle failures unless the user explicitly approves code changes. Config-only notebook changes are acceptable when useful and consistent with the request.
- Do not revert unrelated local changes. Kaggle notebook edits often coexist with dirty source changes.
- For multi-rank validation, do not fake `WORLD_SIZE=2` on one GPU with both ranks on `LO<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="684" />stop the run and inspect downloaded logs. This rule came from project memory and applies to diagnostic/watch tasks.
- Do not stop production/no-timeout runs unless the user explicitly asks or the notebook itself has a configured timeout.
- If a run appears hung because stdout is redirected, check rank log files and whether live-rank streaming is enabled before assuming a stall.
- Preserve logs even when stopping: terminate gracefully when possible, then download output files.

## Failure Diagnosis Checklist

After a Kaggle failure, collect and scan:

- Kaggle worker status and kernel version
- notebook stdout tail
- rank logs under the notebook output directory
- result JSONL/CSV summaries
- GPU budget/preflight output
- explicit Kaggle messages such as disk quota failures

Common patterns in this project:

- `KernelWorkerStatus.ERROR` plus "more disk space than is available" usually means disk quota/static history arena pressure.
- `return_code=-9` can indicate host RAM OOM.
- `code=3002` / `STREAM_FATAL_STREAM3_DOUBLE_BUFFER_OVERFLOW` points to Stream3/Stream4/threshold/capacity flow diagnostics.
- `final selected count does not match score phase counts` points to final selection/histogram/exact-count mismatch.
- `cudaGraphInstantiate: out of memory` may require config-only headroom/shard-capacity changes before deeper code work.
- Silent output after build may simply mean rank stdout is redirected and live rank logging is disabled.

Write a short report under `test_results/` for meaningful Kaggle validations, sweeps, failures, or launches.

## Response Style

- Be explicit about whether you changed source code, notebook config only, or only launched/monitored a run.
- Include Kaggle kernel slug/version/status when known.
- Include exact local report/log paths in `test_results/`.
- Keep recommendations tied to evidence from logs, not guesses.
- If the next step requires exporting source or publishing publicly, ask for explicit approval first.

# Project Agent Rules

## Operating Rule
- Read `AGENTS.md` before project edits.
- Update `memory/CHANGELOG.md` after meaningful code, config, or architecture changes.
- Update `memory/PROMPTS.md` with user prompts that define requirements.
- Store test outputs, logs, and verification notes under `test_results/`.
- Prefer agent-centered code: explicit contracts, deterministic tests, small files, low hidden state.

## Architecture Source
- Primary architecture contract: `ARCHITECTURE_NEED.md`.
- Current Stream 4 implementation rule: use threshold + compact + CUB/fixed-temp sort/reduce + compact; do not use Stream 4 hash-table dedup.

## Implementation Guardrails
- `State128` logical bytes are `v[0..119]`.
- `State128` padding bytes are `v[120..127]`.
- Persistent frontier padding must be zero.
- `FinalResponse` may temporarily store `target_local_idx` in `v[120..123]`.
- `Hash128` is one logical 128-bit key stored as `{lo, hi}`.
- `CandidateMeta` must remain 32 bytes and 32-byte aligned.
- Stream 3 payload id must be original candidate id, not compact index.
- Stream 4 must not apply shard top-k or semantic shard cap.

## 2026-07-06 Cluster Smoke Fix

Cluster job 31743 reached the new pipeline-smoke path, but the first `stream12 window=32 b_micro=512 concurrency=2` run aborted before measurement:

```text
pipeline_smoke_start mode=stream12 window=32 b_micro=512 concurrency=2
what(): CUDA error: cudaMemset(memory.streams.current_threshold_active_index, 0, sizeof(std::uint32_t))
file=.../tools/stream_pipeline_benchmark.cu line=86 message=invalid argument
```

The CMake/Torch warnings in the same log are build noise; the real failure was inside the new benchmark reset path. Existing stream microbenchmarks allocate the threshold triple through `BenchmarkThresholdBuffers` and attach it to `StaticDeviceMemory` before touching Stream3/4 threshold kernels. The new pipeline smoke tool used the static layout threshold pointers directly, which is not the established benchmark pattern.

Fix: `stream_pipeline_benchmark` now allocates and attaches benchmark threshold buffers before reset/graph instantiation, then frees them before `free_static_device_memory`.

Local Docker verification after the fix:

```bash
cmake -S . -B build-stream-pipeline-smoke-fix -DCUTLASS_DIR=/opt/cutlass -DBEAM_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=75
cmake --build build-stream-pipeline-smoke-fix --target stream_pipeline_benchmark contract_tests -j2
./build-stream-pipeline-smoke-fix/contract_tests
```

Result:

```text
[100%] Built target stream_pipeline_benchmark
[100%] Built target contract_tests
contract_tests=pass
```

A100 runtime smoke still needs to be re-run on the cluster after local/Kaggle checks.

# MEPhI HPC Work Rules

Use this skill before giving or running commands for MEPhI HPC work.

For detailed command templates, storage notes, partition details, and source
links, load `references/operational-details.md` only when needed.

## Active Contract

- Entity: `mephi_hpc_work_rules`
- State: `active`
- Account login: `vokirova`
- Entry command: `ssh mephi`
- Current priority second hop: `ssh basis`
- Current priority partition: `kaf12`
- Current submit command: `sbatch -p kaf12 start.sh`
- Job data root: `/mnt/pool/6/vokirova`
- User software roots: `/mnt/pool/3/vokirova`, `/mnt/pool/4/vokirova`

## Secret Safety

Never reveal, print, copy into chat, upload, or send private key contents, the
private key passphrase, or command output containing either. The private key path
may be referenced only as a path:

```text
~/.ssh/MEPHI/id_rsa_mephi_hpc
```

The `.pub` key may be sent only to MEPhI HPC administrators for access
registration or key replacement. Do not ask the user to type a passphrase into
chat; the user handles passphrase prompts locally in the terminal.

## Built-In Codex Terminal Gateway

Always use the built-in Codex terminal as the single command gateway for MEPhI
HPC work. Do not open, target, paste into, or depend on external `cmd.exe`,
Windows Terminal, or GUI terminal windows for routine cluster work.

Codex may run local preparation, SSH, file transfer, SLURM submission, status
checks, and output reads through the built-in terminal. The assistant must relay
the important command output to the user, including job id, job directory,
status, and `slurm-<id>.out` contents.

When the user needs to enter termi<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="473" />`1, 2, 4`. Prefer many small jobs
over one excessively wide job.

## Software And Storage

- Use `/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/<jobname>` for calculation input/output.
- Use `/mnt/pool/3/vokirova` or `/mnt/pool/4/vokirova` for user-installed
  software.
- Do not use the home directory for applications, large datasets, or calculation
  outputs.
- Do not use `sudo`, `su`, or `apt install`.
- Use Python `venv` for all `pip` installs and Python project execution;
  `proot` is allowed.
- Do not rely on internet access from compute nodes. Prepare dependencies before
  compute jobs run: install into a persistent `venv` under `/mnt/pool/3/vokirova`
  or `/mnt/pool/4/vokirova`, or use an offline wheelhouse staged under
  `/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/<jobname>`.
- SLURM compute scripts should activate an existing `venv` and run the workload.
  Avoid `pip install` or network downloads inside compute jobs unless they use a
  staged offline wheelhouse.
- HPC storage is not a backup system; important results need external copies.

## Response Behavior

Before proposing or running HPC commands:

1. Route the work through the built-in Codex terminal.
2. Present commands to the user in chat as explicit command blocks; never use
   clipboard insertion for MEPhI HPC commands.
3. If `ssh` is sandbox-substituted or blocked, use
   `C:\Windows\System32\OpenSSH\ssh.exe` with approval when needed.
4. Classify the action as setup, transfer, compile, queue inspection, or
   computation.
5. For computation, convert it into a SLURM job script and `sbatch` submission.
6. Keep jobs under `/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/<jobname>`.
7. Select a compliant partition.
8. Ensure Python commands use a prepared `venv`; compute nodes may have no
   internet.
9. Avoid stdout/stderr redirection for beginners unless there is a clear reason.
10. Always report the job id and output file path after submission.

Known verified test: `job_id=31060`, `partition=kaf12`, `state=COMPLETED`,
`exit=0:0`, output `Hello`.

# MEPhI HPC Work Rules

Use this skill before giving or running commands for MEPhI HPC work.

For detailed command templates, storage notes, partition details, and source
links, load `references/operational-details.md` only when needed.

## Active Contract

- Entity: `mephi_hpc_work_rules`
- State: `active`
- Account login: `vokirova`
- Entry command: `ssh mephi`
- Current priority second hop: `ssh basis`
- Current priority partition: `kaf12`
- Current submit command: `sbatch -p kaf12 start.sh`
- Job data root: `/mnt/pool/6/vokirova`
- User software roots: `/mnt/pool/3/vokirova`, `/mnt/pool/4/vokirova`

## Secret Safety

Never reveal, print, copy into chat, upload, or send private key contents, the
private key passphrase, or command output containing either. The private key path
may be referenced only as a path:

```text
~/.ssh/MEPHI/id_rsa_mephi_hpc
```

The `.pub` key may be sent only to MEPhI HPC administrators for access
registration or key replacement. Do not ask the user to type a passphrase into
chat; the user handles passphrase prompts locally in the terminal.

## Built-In Codex Terminal Gateway

Always use the built-in Codex terminal as the single command gateway for MEPhI
HPC work. Do not open, target, paste into, or depend on external `cmd.exe`,
Windows Terminal, or GUI terminal windows for routine cluster work.

Codex may run local preparation, SSH, file transfer, SLURM submission, status
checks, and output reads through the built-in terminal. The assistant must relay
the important command output to the user, including job id, job directory,
status, and `slurm-<id>.out` contents.

When the user needs to enter termi<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="473" />`1, 2, 4`. Prefer many small jobs
over one excessively wide job.

## Software And Storage

- Use `/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/<jobname>` for calculation input/output.
- Use `/mnt/pool/3/vokirova` or `/mnt/pool/4/vokirova` for user-installed
  software.
- Do not use the home directory for applications, large datasets, or calculation
  outputs.
- Do not use `sudo`, `su`, or `apt install`.
- Use Python `venv` for all `pip` installs and Python project execution;
  `proot` is allowed.
- Do not rely on internet access from compute nodes. Prepare dependencies before
  compute jobs run: install into a persistent `venv` under `/mnt/pool/3/vokirova`
  or `/mnt/pool/4/vokirova`, or use an offline wheelhouse staged under
  `/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/<jobname>`.
- SLURM compute scripts should activate an existing `venv` and run the workload.
  Avoid `pip install` or network downloads inside compute jobs unless they use a
  staged offline wheelhouse.
- HPC storage is not a backup system; important results need external copies.

## Response Behavior

Before proposing or running HPC commands:

1. Route the work through the built-in Codex terminal.
2. Present commands to the user in chat as explicit command blocks; never use
   clipboard insertion for MEPhI HPC commands.
3. If `ssh` is sandbox-substituted or blocked, use
   `C:\Windows\System32\OpenSSH\ssh.exe` with approval when needed.
4. Classify the action as setup, transfer, compile, queue inspection, or
   computation.
5. For computation, convert it into a SLURM job script and `sbatch` submission.
6. Keep jobs under `/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/<jobname>`.
7. Select a compliant partition.
8. Ensure Python commands use a prepared `venv`; compute nodes may have no
   internet.
9. Avoid stdout/stderr redirection for beginners unless there is a clear reason.
10. Always report the job id and output file path after submission.

Known verified test: `job_id=31060`, `partition=kaf12`, `state=COMPLETED`,
`exit=0:0`, output `Hello`.

# Stream1+2+3 Graph Smoke Bench

## Summary
Сделать отдельный smoke-бенч, который замеряет не только isolated Stream1, а реальные графовые куски dispatcher pipeline:

- `stream12`: Stream1 transformer native graph + Stream2 hash/goal в одном ring-slot CUDA Graph, с `BEAM_RING_GRAPH_EXECS_PER_LANE=16/32/64`.
- `stream123`: то же самое, плюс Stream3 ring graph, но без Stream4/Stream5/history/full solve.
- Сравнить с текущим baseline `native_cutlass graph b_micro=512 conc=2 ~= 4.476M cand/s`.

## Key Changes
- Добавить новый benchmark tool `tools/stream_pipeline_benchmark.cu`, который использует реальные dispatcher/static-memory/graph-template пути, а не отдельную игрушечную реализацию.
- В `cuda/dispatcher` добавить безопасный debug/bench stop-stage:
  - default `Full`, production поведение не меняется;
  - `AfterStream12`: дождаться всех Stream1+2 ring-slot graphs и остановиться;
  - `AfterStream3`: прогнать Stream3 для готовых rings и остановиться до Stream4.
- Расширить `hpc/bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh` режимом `RUN_PIPELINE_SMOKE=1`, который пишет TSV:
  `mode,window,b_micro,concurrency,ring_slots,stream3_batch,graph_window_jobs,physical_jobs,candidates_per_sec,depth_like_ms,status,log`.

## Test Matrix
- Основной smoke на A100:
  - `B_MICRO=512`
  - `STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=2`
  - `BEAM_RING_GRAPH_EXECS_PER_LANE=16 32 64`
  - modes: `stream12 stream123`
  - Stream3 slots не трогать, оставить как в нормальном 700M конфиге.
- Интерпретация:
  - `stream12 ~= 4.4M` значит Stream2 и windowed graph норм, просадка дальше.
  - `stream12 << 4.4M` значит проблема в graph-window scheduler, job-index memcpy/event sync или Stream2 graph kernel.
  - `stream123 << stream12` значит основной проеб в Stream3.
  - если `stream123` норм, а full depth медленный, тогда дальше отдельно смотреть Stream4/5/history.

## Verification
- Локально/Docker:
  - build `production_runner`, новый `stream_pipeline_benchmark`, `contract_tests`, `stream2_cuda_tests`, `dispatcher_cuda_tests`;
  - `ctest` без изменения MLP пути.
- Cluster smoke:
  - сначала один короткий прогон `stream12 window=32`;
  - затем полный sweep `stream12/stream123 x 16/32/64`.
- Записать результаты в `test_results/stream_pipeline_graph_smoke_2026-07-06.md`, а требования/изменения в `memory/PROMPTS.md` и `memory/CHANGELOG.md`.

## Assumptions
- Smoke делаем single-process на `cuda:0`, без NCCL и без Stream5: задача именно найти потери Stream1/2/3.
- Production solver defaults не меняются.
- Никаких fallback-режимов: только явный benchmark mode.

name: benchmark-and-sweep-gpu-configs
description: Use when tuning GPU sweeps.

# Benchmark And Sweep GPU Configs

## Rules

- Fix workload, GPU, driver, CUDA Toolkit, clocks/power when possible, and build flags.
- Warm up graphs, libraries, and setup-heavy paths.
- Sweep one family at a time: batch, concurrency, shards, capacity, topology, or algorithm parameter.
- For beam/search/decoding sweeps, use `optimize-gpu-search-and-decoding`.
- Measure isolated throughput and end-to-end critical path.
- Record memory budget and failed OOM/crash/timeout rows.

Useful columns: `config_id, gpu, arch, batch, concurrency, shards, memory_gib, stage_ms, wall_s, throughput, status, notes`.

Choose the fastest stable point with margin, not the fragile point that barely fits.

---
name: write-cuda-hot-paths
description: Use when writing or optimizing CUDA kernels, memory layouts, and GPU hot paths.
---

# Write CUDA Hot Paths

Primary skill for CUDA code-writing. Hot paths are fixed-capacity, allocation-free, profiler-driven, and explicit about layout, alignment, ownership, and synchronization.

## Workflow

1. State shapes, precision, target GPU, correctness oracle, and measured bottleneck.
2. Choose library vs custom kernel; use custom CUDA where layout, fusion, or control flow makes it worthwhile.
3. Design layout first, implement a small deterministic path, then profile.

## Rules

- Allocate device memory, library temp, NCCL buffers, and graph resources before repeated loops.
- Use explicit capacity guards; fail loudly on overflow.
- Keep CPU readback out of the steady-state path.
- Use CUDA Graphs for repeated launch templates; keep dynamic dispatch on host.
- Add static asserts for cross-kernel metadata size/alignment.
- Store only downstream-needed data; avoid materializing large intermediates when compact keys, indices, or reductions are enough.

## Library Defaults

CUTLASS/cuBLAS for GEMM/tensor-core kernels; CUB/CCCL for sort/reduce/scan/select; NCCL for GPU exchange/collectives; CUDA Runtime/Driver APIs for memory, streams, events, graphs, devices, and peer access.

## Avoid

Dynamic `cudaMalloc`, Python data-plane loops, fine-grained atomics when partition/sort/scan works, custom sort before checking CUB/CCCL, and synchronization that hides ownership bugs.

---
name: use-docker-gpu
description: Use when enabling Docker GPU access.
---

# Use Docker GPU

Use official docs:

- Docker GPU access: https://docs.docker.com/engine/containers/gpu/
- Compose GPU support: https://docs.docker.com/compose/how-tos/gpu-support/
- NVIDIA Container Toolkit install: https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html
- NVIDIA Container Toolkit docs: https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/

## Checks

- Host driver works: `nvidia-smi` on host.
- Docker sees GPU: `docker run --rm --gpus all nvidia/cuda:12.8.0-base-ubuntu22.04 nvidia-smi` or project-approved CUDA tag.
- Container CUDA toolkit can be older/newer than host driver only within NVIDIA compatibility rules.
- Choose `--gpus all`, `--gpus device=...`, or Compose `device_ids` deliberately.
- In containers, compile for the target arch (`sm_75`, `sm_90`, `sm_120`, etc.) based on actual GPU and CUDA toolkit support.

## Failure Smells

- `could not select device driver` or missing `libnvidia-ml.so`: toolkit/runtime/driver wiring issue.
- `nvidia-smi` works on host but not container: Docker daemon runtime config or toolkit install issue.
- Build works but runtime is slow: wrong arch flags, PTX JIT fallback, missing native cubin, or volume/cache bottleneck.

# Benchmark And Sweep GPU Configs

## Rules

- Fix workload, GPU, driver, CUDA Toolkit, clocks/power when possible, and build flags.

---
name: write-cuda-hot-paths
description: Use when writing or optimizing CUDA kernels, memory layouts, and GPU hot paths.
---

# Write CUDA Hot Paths

Primary skill for CUDA code-writing. Hot paths are fixed-capacity, allocation-free, profiler-driven, and explicit about layout, alignment, ownership, and synchronization.

## Workflow

1. State shapes, precision, target GPU, correctness oracle, and measured bottleneck.
2. Choose library vs custom kernel; use custom CUDA where layout, fusion, or control flow makes it worthwhile.
3. Design layout first, implement a small deterministic path, then profile.

## Rules

- Allocate device memory, library temp, NCCL buffers, and graph resources before repeated loops.
- Use explicit capacity guards; fail loudly on overflow.
- Keep CPU readback out of the steady-state path.
- Use CUDA Graphs for repeated launch templates; keep dynamic dispatch on host.
- Add static asserts for cross-kernel metadata size/alignment.
- Store only downstream-needed data; avoid materializing large intermediates when compact keys, indices, or reductions are enough.

## Library Defaults

CUTLASS/cuBLAS for GEMM/tensor-core kernels; CUB/CCCL for sort/reduce/scan/select; NCCL for GPU exchange/collectives; CUDA Runtime/Driver APIs for memory, streams, events, graphs, devices, and peer access.

## Avoid

Dynamic `cudaMalloc`, Python data-plane loops, fine-grained atomics when partition/sort/scan works, custom sort before checking CUB/CCCL, and synchronization that hides ownership bugs.

# Use Docker GPU

Use official docs:

- Docker GPU access: https://docs.docker.com/engine/containers/gpu/
- Compose GPU support: https://docs.docker.com/compose/how-tos/gpu-support/
- NVIDIA Container Toolkit install: https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/install-guide.html
- NVIDIA Container Toolkit docs: https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/

## Checks

- Host driver works: `nvidia-smi` on host.
- Docker sees GPU: `docker run --rm --gpus all nvidia/cuda:12.8.0-base-ubuntu22.04 nvidia-smi` or project-approved CUDA tag.
- Container CUDA toolkit can be older/newer than host driver only within NVIDIA compatibility rules.
- Choose `--gpus all`, `--gpus device=...`, or Compose `device_ids` deliberately.
- In containers, compile for the target arch (`sm_75`, `sm_90`, `sm_120`, etc.) based on actual GPU and CUDA toolkit support.

## Failure Smells

- `could not select device driver` or missing `libnvidia-ml.so`: toolkit/runtime/driver wiring issue.
- `nvidia-smi` works on host but not container: Docker daemon runtime config or toolkit install issue.
- Build works but runtime is slow: wrong arch flags, PTX JIT fallback, missing native cubin, or volume/cache bottleneck.

using namespace beam;

namespace {

std::uint32_t env_u32(const char* name, std::uint32_t fallback) {
    const char* value = std::getenv(name);
    if (value == nullptr || value[0] == '\0') {
        return fallback;
    }
    return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(parse_u64(value, name));
}

std::uint64_t env_u64(const char* name, std::uint64_t fallback) {
    const char* value = std::getenv(name);
    if (value == nullptr || value[0] == '\0') {
        return fallback;
    }
    return parse_u64(value, name);
}

std::filesystem::path env_path(const char* name, std::filesystem::path fallback) {
    const char* value = std::getenv(name);
    if (value == nullptr || value[0] == '\0') {
        return fallback;
    }
    return std::filesystem::path(value);
}

DepthDispatchStopStage parse_stop_stage(const std::string& mode) {
    if (mode == "stream12") {
        return DepthDispatchStopStage::AfterStream12;
    }
    if (mode == "stream123") {
        return DepthDispatchStopStage::AfterStream3;
    }
    throw std::invalid_argument("BEAM_PIPELINE_BENCH_MODE must be stream12 or stream123");
}

std::string stop_stage_name(DepthDispatchStopStage stage) {
    switch (stage) {
    case DepthDispatchStopStage::AfterStream12:
        return "stream12";
    case DepthDispatchStopStage::AfterStream3:
        return "stream123";
    case DepthDispatchStopStage::Full:
        return "full";
    }
    return "unknown";
}

std::uint32_t env_u32(const char* name, std::uint32_t fallback) {
    const char* value = std::getenv(name);
    if (value == nullptr || value[0] == '\0') {
        return fallback;
    }
    return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(parse_u64(value, name));
}

std::uint64_t env_u64(const char* name, std::uint64_t fallback) {
    const char* value = std::getenv(name);
    if (value == nullptr || value[0] == '\0') {
        return fallback;
    }
    return parse_u64(value, name);
}

std::filesystem::path env_path(const char* name, std::filesystem::path fallback) {
    const char* value = std::getenv(name);
    if (value == nullptr || value[0] == '\0') {
        return fallback;
    }
    return std::filesystem::path(value);
}

DepthDispatchStopStage parse_stop_stage(const std::string& mode) {
    if (mode == "stream12") {
        return DepthDispatchStopStage::AfterStream12;
    }
    if (mode == "stream123") {
        return DepthDispatchStopStage::AfterStream3;
    }
    throw std::invalid_argument("BEAM_PIPELINE_BENCH_MODE must be stream12 or stream123");
}

std::string stop_stage_name(DepthDispatchStopStage stage) {
    switch (stage) {
    case DepthDispatchStopStage::AfterStream12:
        return "stream12";
    case DepthDispatchStopStage::AfterStream3:
        return "stream123";
    case DepthDispatchStopStage::Full:
        return "full";
    }
    return "unknown";
}

def write_outputs(commit: str, rows: list[dict[str, str]]) -> None:
    fieldnames = [
        "mode",

    }
    SUMMARY_JSON.write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

    lines = [
        "# Stream Pipeline Smoke",
        "",
        f"- commit: `{commit}`",
        f"- b_micro: `{B_MICRO}`",
        f"- concurrency: `{CONCURRENCY}`",

    ]

                mode=row.get("mode", ""),
                window=row.get("window", ""),
                status=row.get("status", ""),
                candidates_per_sec=row.get("candidates_per_sec", ""),
                depth_like_ms=row.get("depth_like_ms", ""),
                ring_slot_jobs=row.get("ring_slot_jobs", ""),
                stream3_jobs=row.get("stream3_jobs", ""),
                log=row.get("log", ""),
            )
        )
    SUMMARY_MD.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def main() -> None:
    preflight()
    commit = prepare_repo_and_build()
    rows = []
    for mode in MODES:
        for window in WINDOWS:
            rows.append(run_smoke(mode, window))
    write_outputs(commit, rows)
    failures = [row for row in rows if row.get("return_code") != "0" or row.get("status") != "OK"]
    print("PIPELINE_SMOKE_SUMMARY_JSON=", SUMMARY_JSON, flush=True)
    print("PIPELINE_SMOKE_ROWS_CSV=", ROWS_CSV, flush=True)
    print("PIPELINE_SMOKE_FAILURES=", len(failures), flush=True)
    if failures:
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

## 2026-07-06 Cluster Smoke Fix 2

MEPhI cluster job 31745 used the updated benchmark but failed all rows before measurement with `FAIL_134`:

```text
pipeline_smoke_start mode=stream12 window=16 b_micro=512 concurrency=2
what(): CUDA error: cudaMemset(memory.streams.threshold_request_local, 0, sizeof(std::uint32_t))
file=.../tools/stream_pipeline_benchmark.cu line=87 message=invalid argument
```

The previous fix attached benchmark-owned `current_threshold`, `threshold_initialized`, and `current_threshold_active_index`, but the reset path also clears `threshold_request_local` and `threshold_request_global`. Those request pointers must follow the same benchmark-owned-buffer rule because the pipeline smoke tool is not a production full-depth allocation.

Fix: extend `BenchmarkThresholdBuffers` with `request_local` and `request_global`, allocate them with `cudaMalloc`, attach them to `StaticDeviceMemory`, and free them with the other benchmark threshold buffers. Production runner/static layout defaults remain unchanged.

Local Docker verification after the request-buffer fix:

```text

stream_pipeline_benchmark mode=stream12 window=16 b_micro=64 concurrency=1 ring_slots=1 stream3_batch=1536 graph_window_jobs=2 physical_jobs=2 frontier_size=128 ring_slot_jobs=2 stream3_jobs=0 stream4_jobs=0 candidates=3072 depth_like_ms=3.47383 candidates_per_sec=884325 shard_capacity=4096 allocation_bytes=21823744 status=OK

```

Kaggle 2xT4 v3 should run the same cluster-like smoke dimensions with windows `16/32/64`.

## 2026-07-06 Cluster Smoke Fix 2

MEPhI cluster job 31745 used the updated benchmark but failed all rows before measurement with `FAIL_134`:

```text
pipeline_smoke_start mode=stream12 window=16 b_micro=512 concurrency=2
what(): CUDA error: cudaMemset(memory.streams.threshold_request_local, 0, sizeof(std::uint32_t))
file=.../tools/stream_pipeline_benchmark.cu line=87 message=invalid argument
```

The previous fix attached benchmark-owned `current_threshold`, `threshold_initialized`, and `current_threshold_active_index`, but the reset path also clears `threshold_request_local` and `threshold_request_global`. Those request pointers must follow the same benchmark-owned-buffer rule because the pipeline smoke tool is not a production full-depth allocation.

Fix: extend `BenchmarkThresholdBuffers` with `request_local` and `request_global`, allocate them with `cudaMalloc`, attach them to `StaticDeviceMemory`, and free them with the other benchmark threshold buffers. Production runner/static layout defaults remain unchanged.

  - `AfterStream12`: дождаться всех Stream1+2 ring-slot graphs и остановиться;
  - `AfterStream3`: прогнать Stream3 для готовых rings и остановиться до Stream4.
- Расширить `hpc/bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh` режимом `RUN_PIPELINE_SMOKE=1`, который пишет TSV:
  `mode,window,b_micro,concurrency,ring_slots,stream3_batch,graph_window_jobs,physical_jobs,candidates_per_sec,depth_like_ms,status,log`.

## Test Matrix
- Основной smoke на A100:
  - `B_MICRO=512`
  - `STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=2`
  - `BEAM_RING_GRAPH_EXECS_PER_LANE=16 32 64`
  - modes: `stream12 stream123`
  - Stream3 slots не трогать, оставить как в нормальном 700M конфиге.
- Интерпретация:
  - `stream12 ~= 4.4M` значит Stream2 и windowed graph норм, просадка дальше.
  - `stream12 << 4.4M` значит проблема в graph-window scheduler, job-index memcpy/event sync или Stream2 graph kernel.
  - `stream123 << stream12` значит основной проеб в Stream3.
  - если `stream123` норм, а full depth медленный, тогда дальше отдельно смотреть Stream4/5/history.

## Verification
- Локально/Docker:
  - build `production_runner`, новый `stream_pipeline_benchmark`, `contract_tests`, `stream2_cuda_tests`, `dispatcher_cuda_tests`;

- Smoke делаем single-process на `cuda:0`, без NCCL и без Stream5: задача именно найти потери Stream1/2/3.
- Production solver defaults не меняются.
- Никаких fallback-режимов: только явный benchmark mode.

Counting effective work by `final_request_count`, throughput was `874544039 / 285.868 = 3059276` requests/s.\n- The Stream1+2+3 A100 pipeline smoke stayed healthy at about `4.08M` candidates/s, so 'test_results\\stream3_batch_override_2026-07-06.md'), $report, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))\n$change = @'\n- Added opt-in `BEAM_STREAM3_BATCH_CANDIDATES` for manual 8xA100 runs and # Stream1+2+3 Graph Smoke Bench

## Summary
Сделать отдельный smoke-бенч, который замеряет не только isolated Stream1, а реальные графовые куски dispatcher pipeline:

- `stream12`: Stream1 transformer native graph + Stream2 hash/goal в одном ring-slot CUDA Graph, с `BEAM_RING_GRAPH_EXECS_PER_LANE=16/32/64`.
- `stream123`: то же самое, плюс Stream3 ring graph, но без Stream4/Stream5/history/full solve.
- Сравнить с текущим baseline `native_cutlass graph b_micro=512 conc=2 ~= 4.476M cand/s`.

## Key Changes
- Добавить новый benchmark tool `tools/stream_pipeline_benchmark.cu`, который использует реальные dispatcher/static-memory/graph-template пути, а не отдельную игрушечную реализацию.
- В `cuda/dispatcher` добавить безопасный debug/bench stop-stage:
  - default `Full`, production поведение не меняется;
  - `AfterStream12`: дождаться всех Stream1+2 ring-slot graphs и остановиться;
  - `AfterStream3`: прогнать Stream3 для готовых rings и остановиться до Stream4.
- Расширить `hpc/bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh` режимом `RUN_PIPELINE_SMOKE=1`, который пишет TSV:
  `mode,window,b_micro,concurrency,ring_slots,stream3_batch,graph_window_jobs,physical_jobs,candidates_per_sec,depth_like_ms,status,log`.

## Test Matrix
- Основной smoke на A100:
  - `B_MICRO=512`
  - `STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=2`
  - `BEAM_RING_GRAPH_EXECS_PER_LANE=16 32 64`
  - modes: `stream12 stream123`
  - Stream3 slots не трогать, оставить как в нормальном 700M конфиге.
- Интерпретация:
  - `stream12 ~= 4.4M` значит Stream2 и windowed graph норм, просадка дальше.
  - `stream12 << 4.4M` значит проблема в graph-window scheduler, job-index memcpy/event sync или Stream2 graph kernel.
  - `stream123 << stream12` значит основной проеб в Stream3.
  - если `stream123` норм, а full depth медленный, тогда дальше отдельно смотреть Stream4/5/history.

## Verification
- Локально/Docker:
  - build `production_runner`, новый `stream_pipeline_benchmark`, `contract_tests`, `stream2_cuda_tests`, `dispatcher_cuda_tests`;
  - `ctest` без изменения MLP пути.
- Cluster smoke:
  - сначала один короткий прогон `stream12 window=32`;
  - затем полный sweep `stream12/stream123 x 16/32/64`.
- Записать результаты в `test_results/stream_pipeline_graph_smoke_2026-07-06.md`, а требования/изменения в `memory/PROMPTS.md` и `memory/CHANGELOG.md`.

## Assumptions
- Smoke делаем single-process на `cuda:0`, без NCCL и без Stream5: задача именно найти потери Stream1/2/3.
- Production solver defaults не меняются.
- Никаких fallback-режимов: только явный benchmark mode.

    const char* value = std::getenv(name);
    if (value == nullptr || value[0] == '\0') {
        return fallback;
    }
    return parse_u64(value, name);
}

std::filesystem::path env_path(const char* name, std::filesystem::path fallback) {
    const char* value = std::getenv(name);
    if (value == nullptr || value[0] == '\0') {
        return fallback;
    }
    return std::filesystem::path(value);
}

DepthDispatchStopStage parse_stop_stage(const std::string& mode) {
    if (mode == "stream12") {
        return DepthDispatchStopStage::AfterStream12;
    }
    if (mode == "stream123") {
        return DepthDispatchStopStage::AfterStream3;
    }
    throw std::invalid_argument("BEAM_PIPELINE_BENCH_MODE must be stream12 or stream123");
}

std::string stop_stage_name(DepthDispatchStopStage stage) {
    switch (stage) {
    case DepthDispatchStopStage::AfterStream12:
        return "stream12";
    case DepthDispatchStopStage::AfterStream3:
        return "stream123";
    case DepthDispatchStopStage::Full:
        return "full";
    }
    return "unknown";
}

# Stream1+2+3 Graph Smoke Bench

## Summary
Сделать отдельный smoke-бенч, который замеряет не только isolated Stream1, а реальные графовые куски dispatcher pipeline:

- `stream12`: Stream1 transformer native graph + Stream2 hash/goal в одном ring-slot CUDA Graph, с `BEAM_RING_GRAPH_EXECS_PER_LANE=16/32/64`.
- `stream123`: то же самое, плюс Stream3 ring graph, но без Stream4/Stream5/history/full solve.
- Сравнить с текущим baseline `native_cutlass graph b_micro=512 conc=2 ~= 4.476M cand/s`.

## Key Changes
- Добавить новый benchmark tool `tools/stream_pipeline_benchmark.cu`, который использует реальные dispatcher/static-memory/graph-template пути, а не отдельную игрушечную реализацию.
- В `cuda/dispatcher` добавить безопасный debug/bench stop-stage:
  - default `Full`, production поведение не меняется;
  - `AfterStream12`: дождаться всех Stream1+2 ring-slot graphs и остановиться;
  - `AfterStream3`: прогнать Stream3 для готовых rings и остановиться до Stream4.
- Расширить `hpc/bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh` режимом `RUN_PIPELINE_SMOKE=1`, который пишет TSV:
  `mode,window,b_micro,concurrency,ring_slots,stream3_batch,graph_window_jobs,physical_jobs,candidates_per_sec,depth_like_ms,status,log`.

## Test Matrix
- Основной smoke на A100:
  - `B_MICRO=512`
  - `STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=2`
  - `BEAM_RING_GRAPH_EXECS_PER_LANE=16 32 64`
  - modes: `stream12 stream123`
  - Stream3 slots не трогать, оставить как в нормальном 700M конфиге.
- Интерпретация:
  - `stream12 ~= 4.4M` значит Stream2 и windowed graph норм, просадка дальше.
  - `stream12 << 4.4M` значит проблема в graph-window scheduler, job-index memcpy/event sync или Stream2 graph kernel.
  - `stream123 << stream12` значит основной проеб в Stream3.
  - если `stream123` норм, а full depth медленный, тогда дальше отдельно смотреть Stream4/5/history.

## Verification
- Локально/Docker:
  - build `production_runner`, новый `stream_pipeline_benchmark`, `contract_tests`, `stream2_cuda_tests`, `dispatcher_cuda_tests`;
  - `ctest` без изменения MLP пути.
- Cluster smoke:
  - сначала один короткий прогон `stream12 window=32`;
  - затем полный sweep `stream12/stream123 x 16/32/64`.
- Записать результаты в `test_results/stream_pipeline_graph_smoke_2026-07-06.md`, а требования/изменения в `memory/PROMPTS.md` и `memory/CHANGELOG.md`.

## Assumptions
- Smoke делаем single-process на `cuda:0`, без NCCL и без Stream5: задача именно найти потери Stream1/2/3.
- Production solver defaults не меняются.
- Никаких fallback-режимов: только явный benchmark mode.

run_pipeline_smoke_config() {
  local mode="$1"
  local window="$2"
  local b_micro="$3"
  local concurrency="$4"
  local tag="pipeline_${mode}_w${window}_b${b_micro}_c${concurrency}"
  local log="${TUNING_DIR}/${tag}.log"
  local status="OK"
  local rc=0

  echo "pipeline_smoke_start mode=${mode} window=${window} b_micro=${b_micro} transformer_micro=${BEAM_STREAM1_TRANSFORMER_MICRO} concurrency=${concurrency} log=${log}"
  set +e
  BEAM_PIPELINE_BENCH_MODE="${mode}" \
  BEAM_RING_GRAPH_EXECS_PER_LANE="${window}" \
  BEAM_B_MICRO="${b_micro}" \
  BEAM_STREAM1_CONCURRENCY="${concurrency}" \
  BEAM_STREAM3_RING_SLOTS="${BEAM_STREAM3_RING_SLOTS}" \
  BEAM_PIPELINE_SMOKE_RINGS="${PIPELINE_SMOKE_RINGS}" \
  BEAM_SHARD_COUNT="${PIPELINE_SHARD_COUNT}" \
  BEAM_WEIGHT_DIR="${BEAM_WEIGHT_DIR}" \
  "${BUILD_DIR}/stream_pipeline_benchmark" "${PUZZLE_ID}" 2>&1 | tee "${log}"
  rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
  set -e
  if [ "${rc}" -ne 0 ]; then
    status="FAIL_${rc}"
  fi
  local parsed
  parsed="$(parse_pipeline_smoke_result "${log}")"
  echo -e "${mode}\t${window}\t${b_micro}\t${concurrency}\t${parsed}\t${status}\t${log}" >> "${PIPELINE_SUMMARY}"
}
set_backend_runner() {
  local backend="$1"
  case "${backend}" in
    libtorch_eager)
      export BEAM_STREAM1_EXECUTOR=libtorch_eager
      export BEAM_PRODUCTION_RUNNER_PATH="${BUILD_DIR}/production_runner_libtorch_stream1"
      ;;
    native_cuda_graph|cuda_graph)
      export BEAM_STREAM1_EXECUTOR=native_cuda_graph
      export BEAM_PRODUCTION_RUNNER_PATH="${BUILD_DIR}/production_runner"
      ;;
    *)
      echo "unknown_full_backend=${backend}"
      return 2
      ;;
  esac
}

## Summary

- `stream12`: Stream1 transformer native graph + Stream2 hash/goal в одном ring-slot CUDA Graph, с `BEAM_RING_GRAPH_EXECS_PER_LANE=16/32/64`.
- `stream123`: то же самое, плюс Stream3 ring graph, но без Stream4/Stream5/history/full solve.
- Сравнить с текущим baseline `native_cutlass graph b_micro=512 conc=2 ~= 4.476M cand/s`.

## Key Changes
- Добавить новый benchmark tool `tools/stream_pipeline_benchmark.cu`, который использует реальные dispatcher/static-memory/graph-template пути, а не отдельную игрушечную реализацию.

- Интерпретация:
  - `stream12 ~= 4.4M` значит Stream2 и windowed graph норм, просадка дальше.
  - `stream12 << 4.4M` значит проблема в graph-window scheduler, job-index memcpy/event sync или Stream2 graph kernel.
  - `stream123 << stream12` значит основной проеб в Stream3.
  - если `stream123` норм, а full depth медленный, тогда дальше отдельно смотреть Stream4/5/history.

## Verification
- Локально/Docker:
  - build `production_runner`, новый `stream_pipeline_benchmark`, `contract_tests`, `stream2_cuda_tests`, `dispatcher_cuda_tests`;
  - `ctest` без изменения MLP пути.
- Cluster smoke:

## Assumptions
- Smoke делаем single-process на `cuda:0`, без NCCL и без Stream5: задача именно найти потери Stream1/2/3.
- Production solver defaults не меняются.
- Никаких fallback-режимов: только явный benchmark mode.

# Stream1+2+3 Graph Smoke Bench

## Summary
Сделать отдельный smoke-бенч, который замеряет не только isolated Stream1, а реальные графовые куски dispatcher pipeline:

- `stream12`: Stream1 transformer native graph + Stream2 hash/goal в одном ring-slot CUDA Graph, с `BEAM_RING_GRAPH_EXECS_PER_LANE=16/32/64`.
- `stream123`: то же самое, плюс Stream3 ring graph, но без Stream4/Stream5/history/full solve.
- Сравнить с текущим baseline `native_cutlass graph b_micro=512 conc=2 ~= 4.476M cand/s`.

## Key Changes
- Добавить новый benchmark tool `tools/stream_pipeline_benchmark.cu`, который использует реальные dispatcher/static-memory/graph-template пути, а не отдельную игрушечную реализацию.
- В `cuda/dispatcher` добавить безопасный debug/bench stop-stage:
  - default `Full`, production поведение не меняется;
  - `AfterStream12`: дождаться всех Stream1+2 ring-slot graphs и остановиться;
  - `AfterStream3`: прогнать Stream3 для готовых rings и остановиться до Stream4.
- Расширить `hpc/bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh` режимом `RUN_PIPELINE_SMOKE=1`, который пишет TSV:
  `mode,window,b_micro,concurrency,ring_slots,stream3_batch,graph_window_jobs,physical_jobs,candidates_per_sec,depth_like_ms,status,log`.

## Test Matrix
- Основной smoke на A100:
  - `B_MICRO=512`
  - `STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=2`
  - `BEAM_RING_GRAPH_EXECS_PER_LANE=16 32 64`
  - modes: `stream12 stream123`
  - Stream3 slots не трогать, оставить как в нормальном 700M конфиге.
- Интерпретация:
  - `stream12 ~= 4.4M` значит Stream2 и windowed graph норм, просадка дальше.
  - `stream12 << 4.4M` значит проблема в graph-window scheduler, job-index memcpy/event sync или Stream2 graph kernel.
  - `stream123 << stream12` значит основной проеб в Stream3.
  - если `stream123` норм, а full depth медленный, тогда дальше отдельно смотреть Stream4/5/history.

## Verification
- Локально/Docker:
  - build `production_runner`, новый `stream_pipeline_benchmark`, `contract_tests`, `stream2_cuda_tests`, `dispatcher_cuda_tests`;
  - `ctest` без изменения MLP пути.
- Cluster smoke:
  - сначала один короткий прогон `stream12 window=32`;
  - затем полный sweep `stream12/stream123 x 16/32/64`.
- Записать результаты в `test_results/stream_pipeline_graph_smoke_2026-07-06.md`, а требования/изменения в `memory/PROMPTS.md` и `memory/CHANGELOG.md`.

## Assumptions
- Smoke делаем single-process на `cuda:0`, без NCCL и без Stream5: задача именно найти потери Stream1/2/3.
- Production solver defaults не меняются.
- Никаких fallback-режимов: только явный benchmark mode.

# Stream1+2+3 Graph Smoke Bench

## Summary
Сделать отдельный smoke-бенч, который замеряет не только isolated Stream1, а реальные графовые куски dispatcher pipeline:

- `stream12`: Stream1 transformer native graph + Stream2 hash/goal в одном ring-slot CUDA Graph, с `BEAM_RING_GRAPH_EXECS_PER_LANE=16/32/64`.
- `stream123`: то же самое, плюс Stream3 ring graph, но без Stream4/Stream5/history/full solve.
- Сравнить с текущим baseline `native_cutlass graph b_micro=512 conc=2 ~= 4.476M cand/s`.

## Key Changes
- Добавить новый benchmark tool `tools/stream_pipeline_benchmark.cu`, который использует реальные dispatcher/static-memory/graph-template пути, а не отдельную игрушечную реализацию.
- В `cuda/dispatcher` добавить безопасный debug/bench stop-stage:
  - default `Full`, production поведение не меняется;
  - `AfterStream12`: дождаться всех Stream1+2 ring-slot graphs и остановиться;
  - `AfterStream3`: прогнать Stream3 для готовых rings и остановиться до Stream4.
- Расширить `hpc/bench_8xa100_megaminx_transformer.sh` режимом `RUN_PIPELINE_SMOKE=1`, который пишет TSV:
  `mode,window,b_micro,concurrency,ring_slots,stream3_batch,graph_window_jobs,physical_jobs,candidates_per_sec,depth_like_ms,status,log`.

## Test Matrix
- Основной smoke на A100:
  - `B_MICRO=512`
  - `STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=2`
  - `BEAM_RING_GRAPH_EXECS_PER_LANE=16 32 64`
  - modes: `stream12 stream123`
  - Stream3 slots не трогать, оставить как в нормальном 700M конфиге.
- Интерпретация:
  - `stream12 ~= 4.4M` значит Stream2 и windowed graph норм, просадка дальше.
  - `stream12 << 4.4M` значит проблема в graph-window scheduler, job-index memcpy/event sync или Stream2 graph kernel.
  - `stream123 << stream12` значит основной проеб в Stream3.
  - если `stream123` норм, а full depth медленный, тогда дальше отдельно смотреть Stream4/5/history.

## Verification
- Локально/Docker:
  - build `production_runner`, новый `stream_pipeline_benchmark`, `contract_tests`, `stream2_cuda_tests`, `dispatcher_cuda_tests`;
  - `ctest` без изменения MLP пути.
- Cluster smoke:
  - сначала один короткий прогон `stream12 window=32`;
  - затем полный sweep `stream12/stream123 x 16/32/64`.
- Записать результаты в `test_results/stream_pipeline_graph_smoke_2026-07-06.md`, а требования/изменения в `memory/PROMPTS.md` и `memory/CHANGELOG.md`.

## Assumptions
- Smoke делаем single-process на `cuda:0`, без NCCL и без Stream5: задача именно найти потери Stream1/2/3.
- Production solver defaults не меняются.
- Никаких fallback-режимов: только явный benchmark mode.

run_pipeline_smoke_config() {
  local mode="$1"
  local window="$2"
  local b_micro="$3"
  local concurrency="$4"
  local tag="pipeline_${mode}_w${window}_b${b_micro}_c${concurrency}"
  local log="${TUNING_DIR}/${tag}.log"
  local status="OK"
  local rc=0

  echo "pipeline_smoke_start mode=${mode} window=${window} b_micro=${b_micro} transformer_micro=${BEAM_STREAM1_TRANSFORMER_MICRO} concurrency=${concurrency} log=${log}"

  BEAM_SHARD_COUNT="${PIPELINE_SHARD_COUNT}" \
  BEAM_WEIGHT_DIR="${BEAM_WEIGHT_DIR}" \
  "${BUILD_DIR}/stream_pipeline_benchmark" "${PUZZLE_ID}" 2>&1 | tee "${log}"
  rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}

  echo -e "${mode}\t${window}\t${b_micro}\t${concurrency}\t${parsed}\t${status}\t${log}" >> "${PIPELINE_SUMMARY}"
}

+## Full Target Launcher Follow-up
+
+Cluster job `31758` failed before launching the solver:
+
+```text
+invalid_stream1_concurrency=8 stream3_effective_ring_slots=4
+```
+
+Cause: the full target path could also inherit a stale `BEAM_STREAM3_BATCH_CANDIDATES` from the submit shell. That stale value overrode `BEAM_STREAM3_RING_SLOTS=8` and made the helper derive only four effective Stream3 ring slots.
+
+Fix: `run_full_config` now sets a run-local `BEAM_STREAM3_BATCH_CANDIDATES` before deriving/validating manual config:
+
+```text
+BEAM_STREAM3_BATCH_CANDIDATES = b_micro * 24 * ring_slots
+```
+
+For the current 700M Megaminx transformer target:
+
+```text
+8192 * 24 * 8 = 1572864
+```
+
+A custom full-run value can still be supplied through `FULL_STREAM3_BATCH_CANDIDATES`; stale generic shell env no longer changes target/smoke full-run slot geometry.
+
+Verification:
+
+```text
+bash_syntax_ok=1
+```

+## Full Target Launcher Follow-up
+
+Cluster job `31758` failed before launching the solver:
+
+```text
+invalid_stream1_concurrency=8 stream3_effective_ring_slots=4
+```
+
+Cause: the full target path could also inherit a stale `BEAM_STREAM3_BATCH_CANDIDATES` from the submit shell. That stale value overrode `BEAM_STREAM3_RING_SLOTS=8` and made the helper derive only four effective Stream3 ring slots.
+
+Fix: `run_full_config` now sets a run-local `BEAM_STREAM3_BATCH_CANDIDATES` before deriving/validating manual config:
+
+```text
+BEAM_STREAM3_BATCH_CANDIDATES = b_micro * 24 * ring_slots
+```
+
+For the current 700M Megaminx transformer target:
+
+```text
+8192 * 24 * 8 = 1572864
+```
+
+A custom full-run value can still be supplied through `FULL_STREAM3_BATCH_CANDIDATES`; stale generic shell env no longer changes target/smoke full-run slot geometry.
+
+Verification:
+
+```text
+bash_syntax_ok=1
+```

        plan.layout_phase3_materialize_bytes,
    });

        align_up_size(plan.current_frontier_bytes, 256) +
        align_up_size(plan.solved_bytes, 256) +
        align_up_size(plan.scratch_pool_bytes, 256);
    return plan;

std::uint64_t estimate_read_only_table_bytes() {
    return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(MOVE_COUNT) * STATE_STORAGE_LEN * sizeof(std::uint8_t) +
           sizeof(State128) +
           static_cast<std::uint64_t>(STATE_STORAGE_LEN) * STATE_VALUE_PAD * sizeof(Hash128);
}

std::uint64_t estimate_stream1_scratch_b_micro(
    const RuntimeConfig& config,
    const Stream1ModelConfig& stream1_model) {
    if (stream1_model.backend != STREAM1_BACKEND_PIECE_TRANSFORMER) {
        return config.b_micro;
    }
    const std::uint32_t transformer_micro = env_u32("BEAM_STREAM1_TRANSFORMER_MICRO", config.b_micro);
    if (transformer_micro == 0U || transformer_micro > config.b_micro) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("BEAM_STREAM1_TRANSFORMER_MICRO must be in [1, B_MICRO]");
    }
    return transformer_micro;
}

std::uint64_t estimate_non_static_device_bytes(
    const RuntimeConfig& config,
    const Stream1ModelConfig& stream1_model) {
    const std::uint32_t scratch_b_micro = estimate_stream1_scratch_b_micro(config, stream1_model);
    return estimate_read_only_table_bytes() +
           estimate_stream1_weight_bytes(stream1_model) +
           stream1_weights::stream1_scratch_bytes(
               stream1_model,
               scratch_b_micro,
               config.inference_parallelism);
}

std::uint64_t beam_alignment_for(const RuntimeConfig& config) {
    return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.world_size) *
           static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.shard_count) *
           static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.stream4_batch_alignment);
}

std::uint64_t ring_slot_candidate_count(const RuntimeConfig& config) {
    return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.b_micro) * static_cast<std::uint64_t>(MOVE_COUNT);
}

std::uint64_t aligned_global_beam_width(const RuntimeConfig& config) {
    return round_up(config.user_global_beam_width, beam_alignment_for(config));
}

std::uint64_t estimate_read_only_table_bytes() {
    return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(MOVE_COUNT) * STATE_STORAGE_LEN * sizeof(std::uint8_t) +
           sizeof(State128) +
           static_cast<std::uint64_t>(STATE_STORAGE_LEN) * STATE_VALUE_PAD * sizeof(Hash128);
}

std::uint64_t estimate_stream1_scratch_b_micro(
    const RuntimeConfig& config,
    const Stream1ModelConfig& stream1_model) {
    if (stream1_model.backend != STREAM1_BACKEND_PIECE_TRANSFORMER) {
        return config.b_micro;
    }
    const std::uint32_t transformer_micro = env_u32("BEAM_STREAM1_TRANSFORMER_MICRO", config.b_micro);
    if (transformer_micro == 0U || transformer_micro > config.b_micro) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("BEAM_STREAM1_TRANSFORMER_MICRO must be in [1, B_MICRO]");
    }
    return transformer_micro;
}

std::uint64_t estimate_non_static_device_bytes(
    const RuntimeConfig& config,
    const Stream1ModelConfig& stream1_model) {
    const std::uint32_t scratch_b_micro = estimate_stream1_scratch_b_micro(config, stream1_model);
    return estimate_read_only_table_bytes() +
           estimate_stream1_weight_bytes(stream1_model) +
           stream1_weights::stream1_scratch_bytes(
               stream1_model,
               scratch_b_micro,
               config.inference_parallelism);
}

std::uint64_t beam_alignment_for(const RuntimeConfig& config) {
    return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.world_size) *
           static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.shard_count) *
           static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.stream4_batch_alignment);
}

std::uint64_t ring_slot_candidate_count(const RuntimeConfig& config) {
    return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(config.b_micro) * static_cast<std::uint64_t>(MOVE_COUNT);
}

std::uint64_t aligned_global_beam_width(const RuntimeConfig& config) {
    return round_up(config.user_global_beam_width, beam_alignment_for(config));
}
